"mean" — pixels alpha_threshold keep alpha value. heatmap shows mean alpha per pixel across drawings group. Drawings mark pixel count 0, value reflects many participants marked pixel densely drew . alpha_threshold Numeric [0, 1). Pixels alpha less equal value set 0 summing. default 0.05 removes anti-aliased fringe around strokes (pixels partially covered stroke) keeping pixels least roughly half covered stroke .alpha = 0.1. warning given threshold half lowest stroke .alpha data, real strokes may removed. background_image Optional background image displayed behind heatmap. Pass two equal values constant opacity. Defaults c(0, 1). min 0 gives every marked pixel, including marked single participant, visible floor works S-curve. alpha_curve Numeric length 1 2, c(steepness, midpoint), controlling heatmap values mapped opacity within alpha_scale. Steepness controls S-shaped mapping . Higher values fade low values make high values opaque. midpoint fraction scale maximum opacity reaches half alpha_scale. Lower values let moderate areas show ; higher values show hotspots. Moving midpoint away 0.5 bends curve steepness, including 1. title: Plot a pain heatmap from rendered RGBA rasters — pdr_plot_rgba_heatmap
text: function processes data following steps: Validates inputs unpacks pdr_col list-column. Checks .rgba exists drops drawings whose .rgba NULL NA. Drawings -zero .rgba (nothing drawn) kept count towards group size. Creates stratification groups (quantile bins factor levels). Reduces .rgba alpha channel, applies alpha_threshold, binarises value = "binary". Sums alpha matrices within group divides number drawings group, giving share participants ("binary") mean alpha ("mean") per pixel. Converts group matrix long tibble pixel cells (zero cells become NA drawn transparent). Renders heatmap ggplot2::geom_raster(). Opacity mapped cell's value v via u = v / scale_max (capped 1) $$f(u) = \frac{u^k}{u^k + \left(\frac{m}{1-m}\right)^k (1-u)^k}$$ k m steepness midpoint alpha_curve. result rescaled onto alpha_scale. curve always passes 0 u = 0, half opacity u = m, full opacity u = 1. linear k = 1 m = 0.5; k = 1 m < 0.5 concave (low values boosted), m > 0.5 convex. heatmap inherits rendering choices made pdr_add_rgba() (e.g. polygon mode stroke widths). value = "mean", note alpha additive: strokes overlap, alpha builds roughly 1 - (1 - )^k k strokes alpha . mean alpha therefore measure drawing density, count strokes.
